Why Hair Transplant Cost Is Different for Every Patient

Hair transplant pricing is not the same for everyone because every person has a different pattern of hair loss, donor hair availability, and restoration goal.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, we do not recommend a one-size-fits-all package. Your cost is estimated after a detailed scalp and donor area assessment, so the treatment plan is designed for natural-looking results, safe donor usage, and long-term value.

1. Number of Grafts Required

The more grafts needed to cover the thinning or bald area, the higher the overall cost may be.

2. Grade of Baldness

Early hairline recession usually needs fewer grafts, while advanced baldness or crown thinning may need a larger graft plan.

3. Donor Area Quality

A strong donor area allows better planning. If donor hair is limited, the treatment strategy has to be more careful.

4. Hairline Design

A natural-looking hairline needs proper angle, direction, density, and artistic planning.

5. Technique Used

FUE, implant pen technique, NFT Method, beard transplant, and repair procedures may have different cost structures.

6. Density Expectations

Some patients need basic coverage, while others want higher density. This can change the number of grafts required.
Important: A lower quote may not always mean better value. Hair transplant is a medical and aesthetic procedure where planning, safety, surgeon expertise, and natural-looking results matter as much as cost.

Hair Transplant Cost Per Graft in Bangalore

Most hair transplant estimates are based on the number of grafts required to cover your thinning or bald areas naturally.

Hair transplant cost in Bangalore is commonly calculated on a per-graft basis. A graft is the transplant unit taken from the donor area and placed into the thinning or bald area. Each graft may contain multiple follicles, depending on your natural follicle grouping.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the cost range is generally ₹60 to ₹100 per graft. The exact cost may vary based on the surgeon’s experience, number of grafts required, technique used, donor area quality, density planning, and overall case complexity.

For example, a smaller hairline correction may need fewer grafts, while crown restoration or advanced baldness may require a larger session with more grafts and follicles. That is why the final estimate is best given after a detailed scalp and donor area assessment.

Term What It Means
Graft The transplant unit extracted from the donor area and implanted into the thinning or bald area
Follicle The individual follicle unit contained within grafts
Cost Per Graft The price calculated for each graft transplanted
Total Cost Cost per graft × total number of grafts required
Graft Planning Estimating the right number of grafts needed for coverage, density, and natural-looking results
Important Note: The lowest cost per graft should not be the only deciding factor. A successful hair transplant depends on correct graft planning, safe donor area usage, natural hairline design, proper implantation angle, and experienced surgical supervision.

Estimated Hair Transplant Cost by Number of Grafts

Your hair transplant cost depends mainly on the number of grafts required. At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the cost generally ranges from ₹60 to ₹100 per graft, depending on the surgeon’s experience, graft requirement, technique used, and case complexity.
Every patient needs a different number of grafts based on the size of the bald area, donor area quality, follicle availability, and desired density. To make the cost easier to understand, Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic classifies hair transplant sessions based on the approximate number of grafts and follicles required.

A smaller hairline correction may need an ALPHA or BETA session, while advanced baldness or larger coverage may need a GAMMA, MEGA, or GIGA session. The exact session type is recommended only after a detailed scalp and donor area assessment.

Hair Transplant Cost Based on Baldness Grade

The stage of baldness is one of the biggest factors that decides how many grafts and follicles may be required for your hair transplant.

Hair transplant cost is closely linked to the grade of baldness. Early-stage baldness usually needs fewer grafts, while advanced baldness may need a larger number of grafts and follicles to create visible coverage.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the doctor evaluates your baldness pattern, donor area strength, follicle availability, and future hair loss risk before estimating the number of grafts required. This helps create a treatment plan that is realistic, safe, and focused on natural-looking results.

Baldness Grade and Graft Requirement
Baldness Pattern Appx. Graft Requirement Suitable Session Type
Mild hairline recession 1000–1500 grafts ALPHA Session
Frontal hairline + temple recession 1500–2000 grafts BETA Session
Frontal baldness with mid-scalp thinning 2500–3500 grafts GAMMA Session
Crown baldness or larger thinning area 2500–4500 grafts GAMMA / MEGA Session
Advanced baldness with large coverage need 3500–4500+ grafts MEGA / GIGA Session
Note: These are approximate graft ranges. The final graft requirement can vary depending on follicle density, donor area quality, scalp laxity, graft survival planning, and the density expected by the patient.
Important Note: Two patients with the same baldness grade may still need different graft counts. One person may have a strong donor area and thick follicles, while another may have thinner follicles or limited donor availability. This is why a proper scalp and donor assessment is important before finalizing the cost.

What Is Included & Excluded in the Hair Transplant Cost?

When patients compare hair transplant cost in Bangalore, it is important to understand what the quoted price includes.

A hair transplant is not only about placing grafts. It involves consultation, scalp assessment, donor area evaluation, graft planning, hairline design, extraction, implantation, and post-procedure guidance.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the cost estimate is explained after evaluating your baldness grade, donor area strength, number of grafts required, and expected follicle coverage. This helps you understand the treatment plan clearly before the procedure.

However, some additional services may not be included in the basic graft-based pricing. These are usually discussed during consultation, so you clearly understand what is part of the procedure cost and what may be additional. This helps you plan your treatment with complete transparency and avoid confusion later.

What the Cost Usually Includes
Included in Cost What It Means
Doctor Consultation Assessment of baldness grade, scalp condition, and restoration goals
Donor Area Evaluation Checking how many grafts can be safely extracted
Graft Requirement Planning Estimating the number of grafts and follicles needed for coverage
Procedure Charges Extraction and implantation of grafts as per the planned session
Local Anaesthesia Used during the procedure for patient comfort
Post-Procedure Instructions Guidance on washing, care, precautions, and recovery
Follow-Up Guidance Basic follow-up advice to monitor healing and early recovery
Note: The exact inclusions may vary depending on your treatment plan, session type, graft requirement, and whether any additional therapies are recommended. The final cost and inclusions are explained during consultation before the procedure.

Items That May Be Charged Separately
May Not Be Included What It Means
Blood Tests Pre-procedure blood investigations may be advised before surgery
Long-Term Medicines Medicines for maintaining existing follicles may be prescribed separately
Advanced Growth Therapies PRP, GFC, QR678, exosome, or other supportive therapies may have separate charges

Note: Not every patient needs additional therapies or extra sessions. These are recommended only when they may help support follicle health, improve maintenance, or address specific scalp and donor area concerns.

How Neo Follicle Estimates Your Hair Transplant Cost

Your cost estimate is prepared after assessing your baldness grade, graft requirement, follicle availability, donor area strength, and expected coverage.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, hair transplant cost is not decided by guesswork. The doctor first evaluates your scalp, donor area, baldness pattern, follicle density, and restoration goals. Based on this assessment, the required number of grafts and follicles is estimated.

This helps the clinic recommend the right session type, such as ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA, MEGA, or GIGA, depending on your graft requirement. The final estimate is then explained clearly before the procedure, so you understand the expected cost, inclusions, and possible additional requirements if any.

The aim is to give you a transparent cost plan while also protecting donor area safety and planning for natural-looking results.

Our Cost Estimation Process

1. Scalp Assessment

The doctor checks your baldness pattern, thinning areas, and scalp condition.

2. Donor Area Evaluation

The donor area is examined to understand how many grafts can be safely extracted.

3. Graft Requirement Calculation

The approximate number of grafts and follicles required for coverage is estimated.

4. Hairline & Density Planning

The frontal line, coverage area, and density expectations are discussed.

5. Session Type Recommendation

Based on graft count, the suitable ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA, MEGA, or GIGA session is suggested.

6. Cost Explanation

The doctor or clinic team explains the estimated cost, inclusions, and any possible add-ons.

7. Treatment Plan Finalization

Once you are clear and comfortable, the procedure plan is finalized.
Important Note: A proper cost estimate should include both medical and aesthetic planning. The number of grafts is important, but donor area safety, follicle handling, hairline design, and long-term planning are equally important for a good result.

FAQs - Hair Transplant Cost in Bangalore

How is the cost of a hair transplant calculated?

The cost is usually calculated based on the number of grafts you need and the technique used (FUE, FUT, or NFT). After a scalp evaluation, we can provide a personalized estimate.

How many grafts do I need, and how does that impact the price?

The number of grafts depends on the extent of your hair loss and desired coverage. For example, a receding hairline may need 1200–1800 grafts, while full crown restoration may require 2500+. More grafts = higher cost.

Is there a fixed package, or is every case priced differently?

At Neo Follicle, we offer both. You can choose between personalized per-graft pricing or bundled packages that include PRP sessions, follow-ups, and medication.

Are there any hidden charges apart from the quoted cost?

No. Our pricing is fully transparent. We include consultation, graft extraction, implantation, surgeon fees, post-op care, and your recovery kit in the final estimate.

Do you offer EMI or financing options for the procedure?

Yes! We provide easy EMI plans with 0% interest through trusted finance partners. You can spread the cost over several months based on eligibility.

Why do prices vary so much between clinics in Bangalore?

Prices depend on surgeon experience, technique, graft quality, safety protocols, and long-term results. Cheaper doesn’t always mean better—invest in results that last.

How does Neo Follicle’s pricing compare to other clinics?

While we may not be the cheapest, we focus on delivering long-term value. Our price reflects skilled surgical execution, advanced scarless techniques (like NFT), proper hygiene, and high patient satisfaction.

What’s the ROI of getting a hair transplant?

A successful hair transplant is a one-time investment with lifelong results. It boosts your confidence, appearance, and sometimes even your career—making it well worth the cost for many of our patients.
